verdict.rationale: TaxJar's own AutoFile feature is a documented background automation: once enabled, it files state tax returns and remits payments on the user's behalf by each deadline, which implies a recurring schedule. Economic nexus tracking also monitors thresholds automatically. However, these are fixed, vendor-defined automations rather than general automations a user can define and configure. missing for 10: user-definable automation/workflow builder, configurable triggers or schedules, documentation of setup and control for background jobs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: AutoFile handles state tax returns and remittances for you, ensuring deadlines are never missed
TaxJar electronically migrates your state report to your sales tax return, eliminating manual searches and errors – ensuring accurate, on-time filings.
Ideal for businesses that only need automated filing and remittance in the US
